review.batchSummary:
Part 1/5: Reviewed 2 items (each with two context-only variants). Both items measure the skills indicated by their metadata and require no substantive changes.

Part 2/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants). Both items measure paragraph-level writing skills; metadata is coherent and educationally appropriate. Recommend no substantive changes.

Part 3/5: Reviewed 2 items (S2 Chinese writing). Both items measure recognition/application of rhetorical choices (simile identification and appropriate tone for a formal suggestion). Metadata fields are coherent and educationally appropriate; no substantive changes required.

Part 4/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants). Both items measure specific writing-development skills (making content concrete; supporting/expanding an argument) and their metadata are educationally coherent and accurately labeled. Verdict: 2 PASS.

Part 5/5: Reviewed 2 items (and their context-only variants). Both items assess specific writing exam skills (revision for task response/coherence; pre-writing planning and time allocation). Metadata are educationally coherent and accurately label the measured skills.

reviews.reason: The item asks students to select the most appropriate word to describe a behaviour (詞語選擇/詞義辨識). The label '語基與詞語' and topic '語基與詞語' accurately describe this vocabulary/word-choice skill; the module '基礎掌握' is an appropriate classification.
The item requires identifying a grammatically correct sentence (病句辨識 / 句子結構與語法). The label '病句辨識', topic '句子結構與語法', and module '基礎掌握' correctly reflect the assessed skill.
題幹要求選出最適合作為段落中心句的句子，核心技能是辨識段落中心句／段落組織。現有 label「段落組織」與 topic「篇章與寫作組織」直接對應，module「整合表達」在寫作教學上亦屬合理分類，故無需修改。
題目要求從選項中挑出最能支持論點的事例，測量的是用例子支援觀點的能力（選擇有效證據/示例）。label「例子支援」準確，topic「篇章與寫作組織」及module「理解與應用」在寫作與閱讀的教學分類中也屬合理且一致。

The item asks students to identify a simile (比喻). The labeled skill '修辭運用' and topic '修辭與表達' correctly describe recognition/application of rhetorical devices. The module '理解與應用' appropriately captures comprehension and application of language knowledge.

The item assesses choice of appropriate tone/register for writing to the principal. The label '語氣選擇', topic '修辭與表達', and module '理解與應用' accurately reflect the targeted communicative and rhetorical skill.

The item asks how to make the statement “我學會承擔責任” more specific by adding concrete actions, outcomes and reflection. This measures content development / elaboration in writing. The label '內容發展', topic '寫作發展' and module '整合表達' coherently describe that skill.

The item tests argumentative paragraph development—adding reasons, examples and a return to the point to support a claim. The label '觀點深化', topic '觀點發展與論證' and module '整合表達' accurately reflect this skill.
The stem and hint target revision for task response and paragraph coherence. The label '修訂表達', topic '修訂與應試' and module '整合表達' appropriately describe this editing-for-exam-performance skill.
The item assesses pre-writing planning and time-allocation for timed writing tasks. The label '應試策略', topic '寫作規劃與應試準備' and module '整合表達' accurately reflect the skill being measured.
